public_projects.name: Digital Twin: cost-aware memory agent (Qwen Hackathon)
public_projects.description: A permission-aware memory agent built on Qwen that reconstructs what you're working on across GitHub, Slack, calendar and files.
highlights: Routes each task to the cheapest capable Qwen model: a cheap classifier emits a structured descriptor and a deterministic, auditable policy maps it to a model tier.

The classifier chose the right tier on 10/10 of a fixed question set; routing cost 80% of always using qwen-max at equal correctness, with a written benchmark explaining where the savings do and don't come from.
Enforces who may recall what: scoped principals, source-filtered queries, and graph traversal that can't bypass access rules.
